title: TwinConfig
description: Schema for twin.yaml — the contract between a bridge repo and agent-factory.

name.description: Short identifier for this twin (lowercase, no spaces).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this twin does.

owner.description: Email or GitHub handle of the twin's owner.

kernel.description: Pinned kernel reference. source is required and must be a full repo URL.

source.description: Full git repo URL for this twin's kernel (may differ per customer). E.g. github.com/fszale/agent-kernel

version.description: Pinned git tag. Never 'latest' or a branch name.

roles.description: Role identifiers this twin plays (e.g. principal-operator, fractional-cto).

overrides.description: Optional bridge-level overrides layered on top of the resolved kernel.

prompts.description: Relative path to prompt overrides dir.

skills.description: Relative path to skill overrides dir.

models.description: Capability → provider+model routing. Keys are capability names (research, social, engineering, etc.).

model.description: Model identifier as expected by the provider.

api_base.description: Optional override for the provider API base URL.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable name holding the API key. Defaults to provider convention.

store.description: Whether to enable provider-side conversation storage (xAI 'store' flag, etc.).

autonomy.description: Autonomy and HITL policy. propose-then-confirm is the product default.

mode.description: Base autonomy mode. propose-then-confirm is the enforced default.

auto_allow.description: Actions that never require approval, even in propose mode.

always_gate.description: Actions gated through HITL even in full-autonomy mode.

full_autonomy.description: Full-autonomy opt-in. enabled=false by default. Requires a valid guardrails block.

guardrails.description: Hard limits enforced BEFORE provider calls return. All fields required when enabled=true.

daily_token_limit.description: Hard daily token cap across all provider calls.

daily_usd_limit.description: Hard daily USD spend cap across all providers.

max_actions_per_hour.description: Rate cap on actions per hour. Prevents runaway loops.

allowed_actions.description: Whitelist of actions permitted in full-autonomy mode.

kill_switch.description: When true, factory-wide and per-twin pause flags are respected.
